assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire lists 'JEFE/A DEL HOGAR' as the first person to record in the household roster (Page 3, Question 1) and includes 'Jefe/a' as a category for relationship to the head of household (Page 4, Section 1, Question 3). However, it does not establish any method or rule for identifying who the head of household is (whether self-declared by the household, designated by the respondent, or assigned by an explicit criterion). Additionally, document types such as interviewer manuals or methodological notes, which might contain instructions regarding the identification of the household head, were not supplied in this run. Consequently, as the supplied instrument does not establish a method, no option is selected.
